Visit note | 2025-03-26 04:00 PM | Dr. Mehedi Hasan, Ophthalmology | Patient: Rezaul Howlader, 33, male. Mr. Howlader reports a painful red lump at the edge of his eyelid and swelling of the eyelid. He is a homemaker and mentions this appeared during a stressful week in Kushtia. He has no relevant comorbidities and denies visual blurring or discharge. On examination: lump about 7 mm on the right upper eyelid, BP 129/86 mmHg, pulse 75 bpm, weight 64 kg. The eye is otherwise clear with normal movements. Assessment: Hordeolum. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use a warm compress four times a day, do not squeeze the lump, and avoid eye makeup. Follow-up in 1 week.

Visit note | 2025-03-27 02:00 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Dalia Hossain, 43, female. Ms. Hossain describes brittle nails, looking pale, and constant tiredness. She works as an architect and noticed these symptoms after months of skipping lunch during long shifts in Tongi. She has no known comorbidities, and denies chest pain or shortness of breath at rest. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and to avoid tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin.
